scope_note: This identifies the approach as presented by the 2006 editors; it does not make it a single unified school or a closed global taxonomy.
statement: Kim, Yang, and Hwang presented indigenous psychology in 2006 as an emerging field in psychology.
statement_zh: Kim、Yang 與 Hwang 在 2006 年將 indigenous psychology 定位為心理學中正在形成的領域。
